title: Charcuterie Trees
seo_title: Charcuterie Trees Class in Ozark, MO on Dec 9
description: This is a hands-on holiday class where you learn to design and assemble a charcuterie Christmas tree, with guidance from Lavish Grazing on layering cheeses, meats, fruits, and festive touches. All ingredients and supplies are included, and you take your finished tree home. It takes place Wednesday, December 9, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM at The Workshop, 840 Finley Farms Ln, Ozark, MO.
